items.title_zh: 科学、记忆与寻找声音：2026年南亚文学与艺术节的三场对话
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了在2026年南亚文学与艺术节上，科学家们对健康生活方式的看法。核心论点是健康的生活方式应包括适度饮食、良好的睡眠和适度锻炼。科学家们强调，适度饮食可以帮助维持身体健康，良好的睡眠有助于记忆和认知功能，而适度锻炼则能增强身体素质和心理健康。这些观点通过科学研究和数据支持，指出了健康生活方式对个人和社会的重要性，呼吁人们关注并实践这些健康建议。
items.l1_lead: 健康生活方式应包括适度饮食、良好睡眠和适度锻炼，这对个人和社会的健康至关重要。
items.l2_summary:
在2026年南亚文学与艺术节上，科学家们围绕健康生活方式展开了深入的对话，探讨了适度饮食、良好睡眠和适度锻炼对身体和心理健康的重要性。研究表明，适度饮食不仅有助于维持身体健康，还能有效降低慢性疾病的风险。科学家们强调，合理的营养摄入能够为身体提供必要的能量和营养素，从而促进整体健康。

此外，良好的睡眠被认为是提升记忆和认知功能的关键因素。研究显示，成年人每晚应保证7到9小时的睡眠，以便大脑在睡眠过程中进行信息整理和记忆巩固。缺乏睡眠不仅会影响学习能力，还可能导致情绪波动和心理健康问题。

适度锻炼同样被视为健康生活方式的重要组成部分。科学家指出，规律的身体活动能够增强心肺功能，提高身体素质，并有助于减轻压力和焦虑。根据相关数据，成年人每周应至少进行150分钟的中等强度锻炼，以达到最佳的健康效果。

通过这些科学研究和数据支持，科学家们呼吁公众关注健康生活方式的重要性，并积极实践这些建议，以促进个人和社会的整体健康。健康的生活方式不仅能改善个体的生活质量，还有助于降低医疗成本，提升社会的整体福祉。因此，适度饮食、良好睡眠和适度锻炼应成为每个人日常生活中不可或缺的部分。

items.title: Oxygenaging: A Physiological Framework for Geroscience.
items.body: The stepwise movement of oxygen from the atmosphere to the mitochondria, the "oxygen cascade", is one of the most tightly regulated systems in physiology. Despite decades of mechanistic study, it has remained quite unexplored in Geroscience. This oversight should be reconsidered. In young organisms, hypoxic stress (whether environmental or tissue-specific) activates a complex adaptive response to preserve energetic stability via restraining anabolic pathways, optimizing mitochondrial performance, and reinforcing cellular quality control systems. With advancing age, angiostatic signaling increases, endothelial metabolism becomes dysregulated, and overall alveolar ventilation and pulmonary gas exchange (ventilation-perfusion matching and diffusion capacity) become less efficient. These changes promote microvascular rarefaction and low-grade but persistent mismatches between oxygen delivery and demand at the tissue level, ultimately destabilizing cellular function. In this review, we propose that the gradual erosion of oxygen homeostasis is not simply a byproduct of aging, but also a driver of molecular damage and functional decline. We examine the aging oxygen cascade through the framework of resilience biology, focusing on mechanisms such as mitochondrial electron leaks, oxidative stress amplification, iron dyshomeostasis, ferroptosis, and epigenetic remodeling. We also discuss interventions that alter oxygen availability, such as intermittent hypoxia, hyperbaric oxygen therapy, and hypoxic-hyperoxic training. These approaches demonstrate adaptive potential, but they also highlight the narrow margin between beneficial stress and injury. We propose "Oxygenaging" as a unifying framework in which aging associates with the progressive loss of equilibrium across the oxygen cascade, linking systemic oxygen transport to mitochondrial function, genomic stability, and cellular resilience.
items.authors: Donega S, Fishbein KW, Dominelli P, Herman AB, de Cabo R, Gorospe M, Ferrucci L.
items.title_zh: 氧气衰老：衰老科学的生理框架
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了氧气从大气到线粒体的逐步转移，即“氧气级联”，在衰老科学中的重要性。尽管已有数十年的机制研究，但这一领域仍未得到充分探索。年轻生物体在缺氧压力下会激活复杂的适应性反应，以维持能量稳定，然而随着年龄增长，血管抑制信号增加，内皮代谢失调，导致肺泡通气和气体交换效率降低。这些变化造成微血管稀疏和组织层面氧气供应与需求之间的持续不匹配，最终破坏细胞功能。我们提出，氧气稳态的逐渐破坏不仅是衰老的副产品，也是分子损伤和功能衰退的驱动因素。文章通过韧性生物学框架分析衰老氧气级联，重点讨论线粒体电子泄漏、氧化应激放大、铁稳态失调、铁死亡（ferroptosis）和表观遗传重塑等机制。
items.l1_lead: 氧气稳态的逐渐破坏不仅是衰老的副产品，也是分子损伤和功能衰退的驱动因素，揭示了氧气级联在衰老科学中的重要性。
items.l2_summary:
本文探讨了氧气在衰老过程中的重要性，特别是其从大气到线粒体的逐步转移，即“氧气级联”。尽管这一领域已有数十年的研究，但仍未得到充分探索。年轻生物体在缺氧压力下能够激活复杂的适应性反应，以维持能量的稳定。然而，随着年龄的增长，血管抑制信号的增加和内皮代谢的失调导致肺泡通气和气体交换效率的降低。这些生理变化造成微血管的稀疏，使得组织层面氧气的供应与需求之间持续不匹配，最终破坏细胞功能。

文章提出，氧气稳态的逐渐破坏不仅是衰老的副产品，更是分子损伤和功能衰退的驱动因素。通过韧性生物学框架，作者分析了衰老过程中氧气级联的多个机制，包括线粒体电子泄漏、氧化应激的放大、铁稳态失调、铁死亡（ferroptosis）以及表观遗传重塑等。这些机制相互作用，进一步加剧了衰老过程中的细胞功能衰退。

总的来说，氧气的稳态在衰老中扮演着关键角色，其逐渐破坏不仅影响细胞的能量代谢，还可能导致一系列生理功能的衰退。因此，深入理解氧气级联及其相关机制，对于揭示衰老的生理基础和寻找潜在的干预策略具有重要意义。

items.title: The proportion of people with primary affective disorders presenting to early intervention services: systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.body: Background People with affective psychotic disorders often face diagnostic delays and presentations are under-recognised at first contact with early intervention services (EIS). Despite their clinical significance, most research and service models for first-episode psychosis (FEP) have focused on non-affective psychoses. Aims We sought to clarify the relative prevalence of affective psychoses in EIS. Method A systematic review and random-effects meta-analysis of observational studies reporting proportion of affective psychotic disorders among individuals presenting to EIS with FEP was conducted. Eligible studies included treated FEP populations diagnosed using DSM/ICD criteria. Searches were conducted in Web of Science, Medline and PsycINFO (inception to July 2025). The primary outcome was pooled proportion of affective psychotic disorders. Heterogeneity was assessed using Q -statistics and I 2 -statistics. Meta-regressions examined potential moderators, including urbanicity, national income level and geographical region. Results Eighty-three studies ( N = 30 946; mean age 24.95 years; 34.78% female) were included. Random-effects pooled proportion was 18.0% (95% CI 15.4-20.6; 95% prediction interval 3.6-39.4%; I 2 = 95.6%). Schizoaffective disorder represented 7.4% ( k = 49; 95% CI 5.8-9.2). Schizophrenia was the most frequent diagnosis, with a pooled proportion of 45.5% ( k = 79; 95% CI 40.3-50.7). Meta-regression analyses identified that affective psychoses were less common in Asia and more common in North America compared with Europe. Higher urbanicity was also associated with increased prevalence. Associations with national income level (NIL) were limited by small subgroup sizes. Conclusions Affective psychotic disorders constitute a meaningful subgroup within EIS. This suggests better screening, targeted treatments and adaptive service models of care.
items.journal: The British journal of psychiatry : the journal of mental science
items.authors: Catalán A, Swidzinski S, McCutcheon RA, Aymerich C, Pedruzo B, Knox S, Swidzinska P, Tsaligopoulou A, Short R, Carter B, Ratheesh A, Quattrone D, Fearon P, Fusar-Poli P, Young AH, Murray RM, Jauhar S.
items.title_zh: 初级情感障碍患者在早期干预服务中的比例：系统评估与荟萃分析
items.summary_zh: 本研究旨在明确在早期干预服务（EIS）中，初级情感障碍（affective psychoses）患者的相对流行率。通过对观察性研究的系统评估和随机效应荟萃分析，纳入了83项符合条件的研究（N = 30,946；平均年龄24.95岁；女性占34.78%），结果显示情感障碍的合并比例为18.0%（95% CI 15.4-20.6），异质性评估结果为I² = 95.6%。其中，情感性精神病（schizoaffective disorder）占7.4%，而最常见的诊断为精神分裂症（schizophrenia），其合并比例为45.5%。本研究强调了情感障碍在首次发作精神病（FEP）患者中的重要性，呼吁在相关研究和服务模型中给予更多关注。
items.l1_lead: 本研究表明，初级情感障碍患者在早期干预服务中占18.0%，强调了其在首次发作精神病患者中的重要性，呼吁加强相关研究和服务。
items.l2_summary: 本研究旨在探讨初级情感障碍（affective psychoses）患者在早期干预服务（EIS）中的相对流行率。通过对83项符合条件的观察性研究进行系统评估和随机效应荟萃分析，研究共纳入了30,946名参与者，平均年龄为24.95岁，其中女性占34.78%。结果显示，情感障碍在首次发作精神病（FEP）患者中的合并比例为18.0%（95% CI 15.4-20.6），显示出较高的异质性，I²值为95.6%。在具体诊断中，情感性精神病（schizoaffective disorder）占7.4%，而精神分裂症（schizophrenia）则是最常见的诊断，其合并比例高达45.5%。这些数据强调了情感障碍在首次发作精神病患者中的重要性，提示在相关研究和服务模型中应给予更多关注，以改善对这一人群的干预和支持。研究结果为未来的临床实践和政策制定提供了重要依据，呼吁在早期干预服务中加强对情感障碍患者的识别和治疗。

items.title: Cannabis use is associated with increased risk of violence: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.body: Cannabis use is a known risk factor for adverse mental health outcomes, including psychosis, which is frequently associated with aggression. However, the specific impact of cannabis use on the risk of violence remains unclear. This meta-analysis, conducted according to PRISMA guidelines, synthesized evidence from 63 peer-reviewed studies (N = 265,079) identified via MEDLINE, EMBASE, and PsycINFO searches up to November 2024 to clarify the link between cannabis use and violence, either as a perpetrator or as a victim. Random-effects models revealed that cannabis users are at a significantly higher risk of perpetrating violent acts. This association was observed in both psychiatric patients (OR 2.49, 95% CI 1.72-3.61) and the general population (OR 2.05, 95% CI 1.74-2.41), and remained significant across both longitudinal (OR 1.17, 95% CI 1.07-1.28) and cross-sectional (OR 2.37, 95% CI 1.66-3.40) study designs. There was an especially large effect for violence involving a criminal conviction in both general (OR 3.75, 95% CI 2.54-5.53) and psychiatric (OR 4.21, 95% CI 2.86-6.22) populations. Furthermore, cannabis use was significantly associated with an increased risk of becoming a victim of violence (OR 1.49, 95% CI 1.38-1.60), a risk more pronounced in females and mixed-gender cohorts compared to males. This meta-analysis indicates an increased risk of violence, especially that resulting in a criminal conviction, among cannabis users. It also highlights the potential of cannabis use as a target for interventions to decrease violence, and underscores the need for routine assessment of cannabis use among psychiatric patients.
items.authors: Trotta G, Rodriguez V, Marino P, Gurmesa M, Spinazzola E, Li Z, Alameda L, Di Forti M, Murray R, Vassos E.
items.title_zh: 大麻使用与暴力风险增加相关：系统评价与荟萃分析
items.summary_zh: 本研究系统评估了大麻使用对暴力风险的影响，分析了63项同行评审研究（N = 265,079），以明确大麻使用者作为施暴者或受害者的暴力风险。结果显示，大麻使用者施暴的风险显著增加，精神病患者（OR 2.49, 95% CI 1.72-3.61）和普通人群（OR 2.05, 95% CI 1.74-2.41）均表现出这一关联。无论是纵向研究（OR 1.17, 95% CI 1.07-1.28）还是横断面研究（OR 2.37, 95% CI 1.66-3.40），这一结果均显著。此外，涉及刑事定罪的暴力事件在普通人群（OR 3.75, 95% CI 2.54-5.53）和精神病患者（OR 4.21, 95% CI 2.86-6.22）中效果尤为显著。同时，大麻使用者成为暴力受害者的风险也显著增加（OR 1.49, 95% CI 1.38-1.60），女性及混合性别群体的风险更为明显。该荟萃分析表明，大麻使用与暴力风险增加存在显著关联。
items.l1_lead: 大麻使用与暴力风险显著相关，使用者施暴和成为受害者的风险均显著增加，尤其在精神病患者和女性中更为明显。
items.l2_summary:
本研究通过系统评估63项同行评审研究（样本量N = 265,079），探讨了大麻使用与暴力风险之间的关系，旨在明确大麻使用者在施暴者和受害者角色中的暴力风险。研究结果表明，大麻使用者施暴的风险显著增加，精神病患者的施暴风险比值（OR）为2.49（95% CI 1.72-3.61），而普通人群的施暴风险比值为2.05（95% CI 1.74-2.41）。无论是纵向研究（OR 1.17, 95% CI 1.07-1.28）还是横断面研究（OR 2.37, 95% CI 1.66-3.40），均显示出这一显著的关联。此外，涉及刑事定罪的暴力事件在普通人群（OR 3.75, 95% CI 2.54-5.53）和精神病患者（OR 4.21, 95% CI 2.86-6.22）中尤为突出，显示出大麻使用与暴力行为之间的强烈联系。

与此同时，大麻使用者成为暴力受害者的风险同样显著增加，风险比值为1.49（95% CI 1.38-1.60），其中女性及混合性别群体的受害风险更为明显。这一荟萃分析的结果清晰地表明，大麻使用与暴力风险增加之间存在显著的关联，提示社会和公共卫生政策在应对大麻使用及其潜在暴力风险时需给予高度重视。

items.title: Loss of Splicing Homeostasis as a Hallmark of Aging.
items.body: Alternative splicing is a fundamental mechanism that ensures accurate gene expression, supports cellular adaptability, and expands protein diversity beyond the limits of a fixed gene pool. With aging, splicing fidelity weakens, contributing to decline in RNA homeostasis and disrupting essential cellular functions, including mitochondrial oxidative phosphorylation, genome stability, and immune regulation, and in turn accelerating tissue and organ dysfunction. Evidence from senescent cells, aged tissues, and model organisms shows that altered levels of splicing factors and increased RNA polymerase II elongation rates impair co-transcriptional splicing and promote mis-spliced isoforms that reinforce senescence and drive pathology. Dysfunction of RNA-binding proteins further contributes to aberrant splicing, linking splicing defects to age-related diseases such as atherosclerosis, osteoarthritis, sarcopenia, and neurodegenerative disorders like Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. Therapeutic strategies to correct splicing defects, such as antisense oligonucleotides, RNA interference, CRISPR-Cas systems, ADAR-mediated editing, and RNA aptamers, can restore a homeostatic balance of mRNA isoforms. However, major challenges remain, including distinguishing adaptive physiological from pathological splicing 'noise' and achieving targeted delivery to tissues. Despite these obstacles, RNA splicing dysregulation represents a promising avenue to extend health span by reestablishing homeostatic RNA programs, and reinforces the idea that "transcriptomic instability" is a hallmark of aging.
items.authors: Donega S, Gorospe M, Harries LW, Ferrucci L.
items.title_zh: 剪接稳态丧失作为衰老的标志
items.summary_zh: 本文探讨了替代剪接（alternative splicing）在基因表达中的重要性及其与衰老的关系。随着年龄增长，剪接的准确性下降，导致RNA稳态（RNA homeostasis）失衡，进而影响线粒体氧化磷酸化、基因组稳定性和免疫调节等关键细胞功能，加速组织和器官的功能衰退。研究表明，衰老细胞、老化组织和模型生物中，剪接因子的水平变化和RNA聚合酶II延伸速率增加会损害共转录剪接，促进错误剪接的异构体，进一步加剧衰老和病理状态。此外，RNA结合蛋白的功能障碍也与剪接缺陷相关，涉及动脉粥样硬化、骨关节炎、肌肉萎缩及阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病等衰老相关疾病。针对剪接缺陷的治疗策略，如反义寡核苷酸、RNA干扰、CRISPR-Cas系统等，有望恢复mRNA异构体的稳态平衡，但仍面临识别生理适应性与病理剪接“噪音”的挑战。
items.l1_lead: 替代剪接的准确性下降与衰老密切相关，导致RNA稳态失衡，影响细胞功能并加速组织衰退，相关治疗策略有望恢复平衡。
items.l2_summary:
本文探讨了替代剪接（alternative splicing）在基因表达中的重要性及其与衰老的关系。随着年龄的增长，剪接的准确性逐渐下降，导致RNA稳态（RNA homeostasis）失衡，从而影响线粒体氧化磷酸化、基因组稳定性和免疫调节等关键细胞功能，进而加速组织和器官的功能衰退。研究表明，在衰老细胞、老化组织以及模型生物中，剪接因子的水平变化和RNA聚合酶II延伸速率的增加会损害共转录剪接，促进错误剪接的异构体生成，这一过程进一步加剧了衰老及相关病理状态的发生。

此外，RNA结合蛋白的功能障碍也与剪接缺陷密切相关，这些缺陷涉及多种衰老相关疾病，包括动脉粥样硬化、骨关节炎、肌肉萎缩以及阿尔茨海默病和帕金森病等。针对剪接缺陷的治疗策略，如反义寡核苷酸、RNA干扰和CRISPR-Cas系统等，显示出恢复mRNA异构体稳态平衡的潜力，但在实际应用中仍面临识别生理适应性与病理剪接“噪音”的挑战。

综上所述，剪接稳态的丧失被视为衰老的重要标志，其对细胞功能的影响及其在衰老相关疾病中的作用，提示我们在未来的研究和治疗中应重视剪接机制的调控，以期为延缓衰老和改善健康提供新的思路。

items.title: Ferroptotic propagation: from single-cell execution to tissue-scale death programs.
items.body: Ferroptosis has long been regarded as a cell-autonomous form of regulated cell death driven by iron-dependent lipid peroxidation. Recent work, however, suggests that ferroptotic commitment can extend beyond the initiating cell, spreading to neighboring cells and, in some contexts, across tissue-scale distances. Multiple, non-mutually exclusive modes of contagion have now been described, including reactive oxygen species-triggered death waves, direct membrane contact-dependent transfer, and extracellular vesicle-mediated paracrine signaling. These findings redefine ferroptosis from a single-cell execution pathway into a spatially coordinated, multicellular process. In this perspective, we integrate mechanistic insights with experimental evidence on ferroptotic contagion and propose a unifying, multiscale framework in which distinct modes of transmission operate over different spatial scales, from short-range membrane transfer to longer-range oxidative and extracellular relay mechanisms. We discuss how nonlinear redox amplification, membrane biophysics, and tissue architecture together determine the dynamics, limits, and patterning of ferroptotic injury in vivo. This emerging framework has important implications for developmental tissue remodeling, the progression of organ injury, and ferroptosis-based cancer therapy. More broadly, defining how ferroptotic contagion is initiated, constrained, and manipulated therapeutically may help establish ferroptosis as a fundamental organizing principle for understanding tissue-level regulation and pathological escalation.
items.authors: Tang D, Kang R, Kroemer G.
items.title_zh: 铁死亡传播：从单细胞执行到组织规模死亡程序
items.summary_zh: 铁死亡（Ferroptosis）被视为一种依赖铁的脂质过氧化驱动的细胞自主调控死亡形式。近期研究表明，铁死亡的承诺不仅限于启动细胞，还可以传播至邻近细胞，甚至在某些情况下跨越组织尺度的距离。研究描述了多种非互斥的传播模式，包括活性氧（reactive oxygen species）引发的死亡波、直接膜接触依赖的转移以及细胞外囊泡介导的旁分泌信号传递。这些发现将铁死亡重新定义为一个空间协调的多细胞过程。本文整合了铁死亡传播的机制见解与实验证据，提出了一个统一的多尺度框架，其中不同的传播模式在不同的空间尺度上运作，从短程膜转移到长程氧化和细胞外中继机制。我们讨论了非线性氧化还原放大、膜生物物理学和组织结构如何共同决定体内铁死亡损伤的动态、限制和模式。这一新兴框架对发育组织重塑、器官损伤进展及基于铁死亡的癌症治疗具有重要意义。
items.l1_lead: 铁死亡不仅是单细胞的死亡机制，还可以通过多种方式在组织中传播，重新定义为一个空间协调的多细胞过程，对组织重塑和癌症治疗具有重要影响。
items.l2_summary:
铁死亡（Ferroptosis）是一种依赖铁的脂质过氧化驱动的细胞自主调控死亡形式，近年来的研究揭示了其传播特性，超越了单细胞的死亡机制，能够影响邻近细胞，甚至在某些情况下跨越组织尺度。研究表明，铁死亡的传播模式多样且非互斥，主要包括活性氧（reactive oxygen species）引发的死亡波、直接膜接触依赖的转移以及细胞外囊泡介导的旁分泌信号传递。这些发现使铁死亡的概念得以重新定义为一个空间协调的多细胞过程。

在这一研究中，作者整合了铁死亡传播的机制见解与实验证据，提出了一个统一的多尺度框架，强调不同的传播模式在不同的空间尺度上运作，从短程的膜转移到长程的氧化和细胞外中继机制。通过分析非线性氧化还原放大、膜生物物理学和组织结构，研究指出这些因素共同决定了体内铁死亡损伤的动态、限制和模式。这一新兴框架不仅为理解发育组织重塑和器官损伤的进展提供了新的视角，还对基于铁死亡的癌症治疗具有重要的启示。

总之，铁死亡的传播特性及其在多细胞环境中的作用，揭示了细胞死亡机制的复杂性和多样性，为未来的生物医学研究和临床应用提供了新的方向。

items.title: Molecular damage associated with ageing drives inflammation in cardiovascular disease.
items.body: Chronic inflammation has long been recognized as a major risk factor for and a causal contributor to cardiovascular disease (CVD). However, advances in omics technologies and deepening insights into CVD pathogenesis have expanded our understanding of the underlying mechanisms. Inflammation is now seen not as an isolated cause, but as one of several biological responses to cumulative tissue damage over time. In this Review, we propose that inflammation initially functions as a resilience mechanism, acting to resolve molecular and cellular damage driven by environmental stressors and intrinsic age-related entropy. With ageing, however, this protective response can become dysregulated and maladaptive, promoting collateral pathological changes. We illustrate this theory through two examples, atherosclerosis and age-related impairment of tissue perfusion, and support these conceptual models using proteomic data from large population studies with cardiovascular outcomes. Our findings reaffirm the central role of inflammation in CVD pathophysiology, but also indicate that the upstream biological driver of inflammation is molecular damage that is either not readily prevented or repaired by inadequate resilience mechanisms. Understanding the coordination of these responses offers new opportunities for targeted prevention and treatment of CVD.
items.authors: Herman AB, Candia J, Wilson DM, Donega S, Picard M, Ferrucci L.
items.title_zh: 与衰老相关的分子损伤驱动心血管疾病中的炎症
items.summary_zh: 慢性炎症被广泛认为是心血管疾病（CVD）的主要风险因素和致病因素。随着组学技术的进步和对CVD发病机制的深入理解，炎症不再被视为孤立的原因，而是对累积的组织损伤的生物反应之一。本文提出，炎症最初作为一种抵御机制，旨在解决由环境压力和内在衰老引起的分子和细胞损伤。然而，随着年龄的增长，这种保护性反应可能失调并适应不良，促进病理变化的发生。我们通过动脉粥样硬化和与年龄相关的组织灌注障碍两个例子来阐述这一理论，并利用大型人群研究的蛋白组学数据支持这些概念模型。研究结果重申了炎症在CVD病理生理学中的核心作用，同时表明炎症的上游生物驱动因素是分子损伤，这种损伤无法通过不足的抵御机制有效预防或修复。理解这些反应的协调为CVD的针对性预防和治疗提供了新的机会。
items.l1_lead: 慢性炎症是心血管疾病的关键因素，其根源在于衰老引起的分子损伤，理解这一过程有助于改善预防和治疗策略。
items.l2_summary:
慢性炎症被广泛认为是心血管疾病（CVD）的主要风险因素和致病因素。随着组学技术的进步和对CVD发病机制的深入理解，炎症不再被视为孤立的原因，而是对累积的组织损伤的生物反应之一。本文提出，炎症最初作为一种抵御机制，旨在解决由环境压力和内在衰老引起的分子和细胞损伤。然而，随着年龄的增长，这种保护性反应可能失调并适应不良，促进病理变化的发生。

通过动脉粥样硬化和与年龄相关的组织灌注障碍两个例子，本文阐述了这一理论，并利用大型人群研究的蛋白组学数据支持这些概念模型。这些研究结果重申了炎症在CVD病理生理学中的核心作用，同时表明炎症的上游生物驱动因素是分子损伤，这种损伤无法通过不足的抵御机制有效预防或修复。理解这些反应的协调为CVD的针对性预防和治疗提供了新的机会。

总的来说，本文强调了分子损伤在心血管疾病中的重要性，指出随着年龄的增长，炎症反应的失调可能加剧心血管疾病的发生和发展。这一发现为未来的研究和临床干预提供了新的视角，强调了在预防和治疗心血管疾病时，关注分子损伤及其引发的炎症反应的重要性。

items.title: Immune aging biomarkers for clinical trials.
items.body: Aging profoundly remodels the immune system, impairing defense, repair and homeostatic function across tissues. Because the immune system operates in every organ, its deterioration has been proposed to drive or exacerbate systemic dysfunction and accelerate overall biological aging, making it an attractive biomarker and target for geroscience-guided trials. Despite this central role, there is no consensus on how to quantify immune aging, especially in clinical trials. Here, we establish a translational framework to identify immune aging biomarkers for this purpose. We define five evaluation criteria for immune aging biomarkers and apply these to candidate biomarkers, discussing their utility in the context of a major international healthspan competition, XPRIZE Healthspan. Metrics encapsulating multidimensional aspects of immune function, inflammaging scores and functional assays performed best against our selection criteria. Finally, we identify promising emerging measures, together with critical gaps that must be addressed to develop reliable, predictive biomarkers of human immune competence. Our framework provides a coherent path toward actionable and clinically meaningful immune aging biomarkers capable of quantifying immune fitness and resilience, and accelerating the clinical translation of geroscience-guided interventions.
items.authors: Cipriano A, Justice J, Poganik JR, Moqri M, Abudayyeh OO, Gootenberg J, Haynes L, Levin Y, Martin-Herranz DE, Akbar AN, Mannick J, Pawelec G, Shen-Orr SS, Tsang J, Wagner W, Merad M, Gnjatic S, Gellhorn A, Corley MJ, Kuc

items.title_zh: 免疫衰老生物标志物在临床试验中的应用
items.summary_zh: 免疫系统在衰老过程中发生深刻重塑，影响防御、修复和稳态功能，进而可能加速全身性功能障碍和生物衰老。因此，免疫衰老被视为老年科学（geroscience）试验中的重要生物标志物和靶点。尽管免疫衰老在这一领域的核心作用明显，但目前尚无统一的量化标准。本文建立了一个转化框架，以识别免疫衰老生物标志物，并定义了五个评估标准。通过对候选生物标志物的应用，讨论其在国际健康寿命竞赛XPRIZE Healthspan中的实用性。多维免疫功能指标、炎症衰老评分和功能性检测在评估标准中表现最佳。最后，本文识别出有前景的新兴指标及需解决的关键问题，以开发可靠的免疫能力预测生物标志物。该框架为量化免疫健康和韧性提供了可行路径，推动老年科学干预的临床转化。
items.l1_lead: 免疫衰老被视为老年科学的重要生物标志物，本文建立了评估框架并识别出有前景的指标，以推动其在临床试验中的应用。
items.l2_summary:
免疫系统在衰老过程中经历显著的重塑，这种变化对机体的防御、修复和稳态功能产生深远影响，可能加速全身性功能障碍和生物衰老。因此，免疫衰老（immunosenescence）被认为是老年科学（geroscience）研究中的一个重要生物标志物和靶点。尽管免疫衰老在这一领域的核心作用已得到广泛认可，但目前尚缺乏统一的量化标准。为此，本文建立了一个转化框架，以识别免疫衰老生物标志物，并定义了五个评估标准，以便于在临床试验中应用。

在对候选生物标志物的应用中，本文探讨了其在国际健康寿命竞赛XPRIZE Healthspan中的实用性。研究表明，多维免疫功能指标、炎症衰老评分和功能性检测在评估标准中表现最佳，显示出较强的应用潜力。这些指标能够有效反映个体的免疫健康状况，并为临床干预提供重要依据。

此外，本文还识别出了一些有前景的新兴指标，并指出了在开发可靠的免疫能力预测生物标志物过程中需要解决的关键问题。这些新兴指标的探索将为量化免疫健康和韧性提供可行路径，进而推动老年科学干预的临床转化。通过建立这一框架，研究者们希望能够为老年人群体的健康管理提供更为科学的依据，促进其生活质量的提升。总之，免疫衰老作为一个重要的生物标志物，其量化和评估将为未来的老年科学研究和临床应用开辟新的方向。

items.title: Translating ferroptosis into oncology: challenges, opportunities and future directions.
items.body: Ferroptosis is an oxidative, lipid peroxidation-driven form of regulated cell death that occurs when antioxidant and organelle-protective systems are compromised. Increasing evidence implicates ferroptosis as a process that can exert both tumour-suppressive and tumour-promoting effects depending on cellular context at multiple stages of cancer evolution (from tumour initiation to metastatic colonization), sparking substantial interest in therapeutically exploiting this mechanism of cell death. Yet, despite rapid preclinical progress, clinical translation of ferroptosis-based strategies remains nascent. In this Review, we examine the major barriers to translation, including pharmacological limitations, tumour-intrinsic heterogeneity, microenvironmental and immune constraints, and gaps in current preclinical modelling. We also highlight emerging opportunities such as new ferroptosis-inducing agents, biomarker-guided patient selection and rational combinations with chemotherapy, radiotherapy, targeted agents or immunotherapies. Finally, we outline a translational roadmap for integrating ferroptosis-based therapies into oncology practice. By defining key challenges and future directions, this Review aims to position ferroptosis as a viable therapeutic paradigm and to accelerate progress towards clinical application.
items.authors: Kang R, Liu J, Wang J, Kroemer G, Tang D.
items.title_zh: 将铁死亡转化为肿瘤学：挑战与机遇
items.summary_zh: 铁死亡（ferroptosis）是一种由氧化和脂质过氧化驱动的调控性细胞死亡形式，发生在抗氧化和细胞器保护系统受损时。越来越多的证据表明，铁死亡在癌症演化的多个阶段（从肿瘤启动到转移性殖民）中，可能具有抑制肿瘤和促进肿瘤的双重效应，这引发了对这一细胞死亡机制的治疗性利用的广泛关注。然而，尽管在临床前研究中取得了快速进展，基于铁死亡的策略在临床转化方面仍处于初期阶段。本文评估了转化过程中的主要障碍，包括药物限制、肿瘤内在异质性、微环境和免疫约束，以及当前临床前模型的不足。同时，文章强调了新型铁死亡诱导剂、基于生物标志物的患者选择以及与化疗、放疗、靶向药物或免疫疗法的合理组合等新兴机遇。最后，本文概述了将基于铁死亡的疗法整合到肿瘤学实践中的转化路线图，旨在明确关键挑战和未来方向，将铁死亡定位为一种可行的治疗范式，加速其临床应用的进展。
items.l1_lead: 铁死亡在癌症发展中具有双重效应，尽管临床转化面临挑战，但新兴治疗机会和整合策略可能加速其应用于肿瘤学。
items.l2_summary:
铁死亡（ferroptosis）是一种由氧化和脂质过氧化驱动的调控性细胞死亡形式，通常在抗氧化和细胞器保护系统受损时发生。近年来，研究表明铁死亡在癌症的多个阶段中可能发挥双重作用，既能抑制肿瘤的发生，也可能促进肿瘤的转移，这一发现引发了对铁死亡机制在肿瘤治疗中应用的广泛关注。尽管在临床前研究中取得了一定进展，基于铁死亡的治疗策略在临床转化方面仍处于初期阶段，面临诸多挑战。

文章评估了转化过程中存在的主要障碍，包括药物的限制、肿瘤内在的异质性、微环境的影响以及免疫约束等因素。此外，当前的临床前模型也存在不足，限制了对铁死亡机制的深入理解和应用。尽管如此，研究者们也发现了一些新兴的机遇，例如开发新型铁死亡诱导剂、基于生物标志物的患者选择，以及与化疗、放疗、靶向药物或免疫疗法的合理组合，这些都为铁死亡的临床应用提供了新的可能性。

最后，文章提出了一条将基于铁死亡的疗法整合到肿瘤学实践中的转化路线图，旨在明确关键挑战和未来方向，以将铁死亡定位为一种可行的治疗范式，推动其在临床应用中的进展。通过解决上述障碍并抓住新机遇，铁死亡有望在癌症治疗中发挥重要作用。

items.title: Pro-aging effects of chronic glucocorticoid signaling.
items.body: Glucocorticoids (GCs) are essential endocrine regulators coordinating stress responsiveness, metabolic flexibility, inflammatory resolution, and circadian physiology. While acute GC fluctuations are adaptive, sustained exposure (arising from psychosocial stress, circadian disruption, obesity, chronic inflammation, neoplasms, or steroid therapy) elicits pleiotropic effects that overlap with biological aging. Prolonged GC signaling intersects with multiple hallmarks of aging by altering nutrient sensing, suppressing autophagy, impairing mitochondrial quality control, and promoting cellular senescence. In this context, the GC-responsive polypeptide ACBP/DBI (acyl-coenzyme A [CoA]-binding protein/diazepam-binding inhibitor) has emerged as a stress-induced inhibitor of macroautophagy that amplifies several metabolic and immune consequences of GC excess linked to aging phenotypes. Clinically, chronic GC elevation is associated with earlier and more severe manifestations of age-related diseases, including metabolic syndrome, osteoporosis, sarcopenia, neurodegeneration, cardiovascular disease, immunosenescence, and cancer. Here, we review mechanistic links between GC signaling and systemic aging and discuss strategies to mitigate the age-accelerating consequences of persistent GC exposure.
items.authors: Lambertucci F, Castinetti F, Martins I, López-Otín C, Kroemer G.
items.title_zh: 慢性糖皮质激素信号的促衰老效应
items.summary_zh: 糖皮质激素（GCs）是调节应激反应、代谢灵活性、炎症解决和昼夜生理的重要内分泌因子。虽然急性GC波动具有适应性，但持续的GC暴露（源于心理社会压力、昼夜节律紊乱、肥胖、慢性炎症、肿瘤或类固醇治疗）会引发与生物衰老重叠的多重效应。长期GC信号通过改变营养感知、抑制自噬、损害线粒体质量控制和促进细胞衰老，影响衰老的多个标志。GC响应多肽ACBP/DBI（酰基辅酶A结合蛋白/地西泮结合抑制剂）作为一种应激诱导的巨自噬抑制因子，放大了与衰老表型相关的GC过量的代谢和免疫后果。临床上，慢性GC升高与代谢综合症、骨质疏松、肌肉减少、神经退行性疾病、心血管疾病、免疫衰老和癌症等年龄相关疾病的早期和严重表现相关。本文回顾了GC信号与系统性衰老之间的机制联系，并讨论了减轻持续GC暴露加速衰老后果的策略。
items.l1_lead: 慢性糖皮质激素暴露通过多种机制加速衰老过程，并与多种年龄相关疾病的发生和严重程度密切相关。
items.l2_summary:
糖皮质激素（GCs）是调节应激反应、代谢灵活性、炎症解决和昼夜生理的重要内分泌因子。尽管急性GC波动具有适应性，但持续的GC暴露会引发与生物衰老相关的多重效应。这种持续暴露可能源于心理社会压力、昼夜节律紊乱、肥胖、慢性炎症、肿瘤或类固醇治疗等因素。长期的GC信号通过改变营养感知、抑制自噬、损害线粒体质量控制和促进细胞衰老，影响衰老的多个标志。

研究表明，GC响应多肽ACBP/DBI（酰基辅酶A结合蛋白/地西泮结合抑制剂）作为一种应激诱导的巨自噬抑制因子，能够放大与衰老表型相关的GC过量的代谢和免疫后果。这一发现强调了GC在衰老过程中的重要作用，尤其是在代谢综合症、骨质疏松、肌肉减少、神经退行性疾病、心血管疾病、免疫衰老和癌症等年龄相关疾病的早期和严重表现中，慢性GC升高与这些疾病的发生有着密切的关联。

综上所述，本文回顾了GC信号与系统性衰老之间的机制联系，指出了持续GC暴露对衰老的加速作用，并讨论了减轻这一影响的潜在策略。这些研究为理解衰老过程中的内分泌调节提供了新的视角，同时也为临床上应对与衰老相关的疾病提供了重要的理论基础。

items.title: Immunobiological mechanisms of action of oncolytic peptides.
items.body: Oncolytic peptides (OLPs) constitute an emerging class of immunotherapeutics that combine direct cancer cell lysis with immune activation. Indeed, OLPs induce rapid immunogenic cell death by disrupting intracellular membranes, which culminates with the abundant release of malignant cell contents including immunostimulatory danger-associated molecular patterns. This results in the engagement of innate immune sensors that potently activate dendritic cells, leading to the cross-priming of tumor-specific T lymphocytes that mediate systemic anticancer immunity. Through such a dual mechanism, OLPs can remodel the tumor microenvironment and overcome resistance to therapy as promoted by intratumoral heterogeneity, hence representing optimal combinatorial partners for immune checkpoint inhibitors. Some OLPs have also shown remarkable clinical efficacy. For instance, LTX-315 (studied as VP-315 in basal cell carcinoma (BCC)) has recently been shown to enable complete and durable responses in patients with BCC, and emerging evidence points to a significant activity of LTX-315 in immunologically cold tumors. Here, we summarize recent mechanistic, preclinical, and clinical advances in OLP development, underscoring their potential as a versatile and powerful modality of cancer immunotherapy.
items.authors: Kepp O, Deng X, Xue E, Sveinbjørnsson B, Rekdal Ø, Galluzzi L, Kroemer G.
items.title_zh: 肿瘤溶解肽的免疫生物学作用机制
items.summary_zh: 肿瘤溶解肽（Oncolytic Peptides, OLPs）是一类新兴的免疫治疗药物，能够直接裂解癌细胞并激活免疫反应。OLPs通过破坏细胞内膜诱导快速的免疫原性细胞死亡，释放出包括免疫刺激性危险相关分子模式在内的恶性细胞内容物。这一过程激活了先天免疫传感器，强效激活树突状细胞，促进肿瘤特异性T淋巴细胞的交叉激活，从而介导系统性的抗癌免疫。通过这种双重机制，OLPs能够重塑肿瘤微环境，克服由肿瘤内部异质性引起的治疗抵抗，因此与免疫检查点抑制剂形成理想的组合伙伴。一些OLPs已显示出显著的临床疗效，例如LTX-315（在基底细胞癌中研究为VP-315）最近被证明能在基底细胞癌患者中实现完全且持久的反应，且新兴证据表明LTX-315在免疫冷肿瘤中也具有显著活性。本文总结了OLP开发的最新机制、临床前和临床进展，强调其作为一种多功能且强大的癌症免疫治疗方式的潜力。
items.l1_lead: 肿瘤溶解肽通过直接裂解癌细胞和激活免疫反应，展现出重塑肿瘤微环境和克服治疗抵抗的潜力，成为一种强大的癌症免疫治疗方式。
items.l2_summary:
肿瘤溶解肽（Oncolytic Peptides, OLPs）是一类新兴的免疫治疗药物，具有直接裂解癌细胞和激活免疫反应的能力。OLPs通过破坏癌细胞内膜，诱导快速的免疫原性细胞死亡，进而释放出包括免疫刺激性危险相关分子模式在内的恶性细胞内容物。这一过程能够激活先天免疫传感器，强效激活树突状细胞，并促进肿瘤特异性T淋巴细胞的交叉激活，从而介导系统性的抗癌免疫反应。通过这种双重机制，OLPs不仅能够重塑肿瘤微环境，还能有效克服由肿瘤内部异质性引起的治疗抵抗，因此与免疫检查点抑制剂形成理想的组合伙伴。

在临床研究中，一些OLPs已显示出显著的疗效。例如，LTX-315（在基底细胞癌中研究为VP-315）最近被证明能够在基底细胞癌患者中实现完全且持久的反应。此外，新兴证据表明，LTX-315在免疫冷肿瘤中也展现出显著的活性。这些研究结果强调了OLPs作为一种多功能且强大的癌症免疫治疗方式的潜力，表明其在未来的癌症治疗中可能发挥重要作用。本文总结了OLP开发的最新机制、临床前和临床进展，突出了其在癌症免疫治疗领域的广泛应用前景。

items.title: Progress, challenges, and opportunities in the field of biosynthetic reactions involving ambimodal transition states.
items.body: Covering: up to June 2025High selectivity is generally observed in the biosynthesis of complex natural molecules. Evolution usually leads to enzymes that favor the formation of a particular isomer rather than one of the many other potential molecules. Recent discoveries of enzymes with multiple sequential post-transition state bifurcations (PTSB) after ambimodal transition states demonstrate the impact of dynamics on selectivity. PTSB cause a single ambimodal transition state (TS) to form multiple products. This is different from conventional energetically-controlled mechanisms, where two discrete transition states have different energy barriers. Selectivity arising from ambimodal TSs cannot be fully explained by transition state theory. The presence of PTSB on enzyme catalyzed reaction surfaces has been discovered recently at a significantly higher rate. For both uncatalyzed and catalyzed reactions, computational chemists are devising techniques to comprehend which elements of molecular structure and vibrations govern the product selectivity in systems that contain bifurcations. This review describes enzyme-catalyzed reactions involving ambimodal transition states, and recent advances in understanding how enzymes control selectivity in such reactions.
items.authors: Hussain H, Houk KN, Lam CC, Sarker SD, Nahar L.
items.title_zh: 生物合成反应中双模态过渡态的进展与挑战
items.summary_zh: 本文评述了涉及双模态过渡态（ambimodal transition states）的酶催化反应，探讨了其在复杂天然分子生物合成中的高选择性。进化通常促使酶偏向于形成特定异构体，而非众多其他潜在分子。近期发现的多重后过渡态分叉（post-transition state bifurcations, PTSB）现象表明，动态因素对选择性的影响。PTSB使得单一的双模态过渡态能够生成多种产物，这与传统的能量控制机制不同。双模态过渡态所产生的选择性无法完全用过渡态理论解释。计算化学家正在开发技术，以理解在包含分叉的体系中，分子结构和振动的哪些元素主导产物选择性。本文总结了酶催化反应的最新进展，阐明了酶如何控制此类反应中的选择性。
items.l1_lead: 本文探讨了双模态过渡态在酶催化反应中的作用，揭示了动态因素对产物选择性的影响及其与传统能量控制机制的不同。
items.l2_summary:
本文评述了双模态过渡态（ambimodal transition states）在酶催化反应中的重要性，特别是在复杂天然分子生物合成中的高选择性。研究表明，酶的进化通常使其倾向于生成特定的异构体，而非众多其他可能的分子。这一现象的理解对于生物合成反应的优化和设计具有重要意义。近期的研究发现了多重后过渡态分叉（post-transition state bifurcations, PTSB）现象，揭示了动态因素在选择性中的关键作用。PTSB现象表明，单一的双模态过渡态可以通过不同的反应路径生成多种产物，这一机制与传统的能量控制理论有所不同，挑战了我们对过渡态的理解。

在这一背景下，双模态过渡态所产生的选择性并不能完全通过经典的过渡态理论来解释。为了解释这一现象，计算化学家们正在开发新的技术，以深入理解在包含分叉的体系中，哪些分子结构和振动因素主导了产物的选择性。这一研究进展不仅为酶催化反应的机制提供了新的视角，也为未来的生物合成反应设计提供了理论基础。

总的来说，本文总结了酶催化反应的最新进展，强调了双模态过渡态及其后过渡态分叉现象在选择性控制中的重要性。这些发现为我们理解酶的催化机制提供了新的思路，并为生物合成领域的研究和应用开辟了新的方向。

items.title: Hierarchical endpoints and win statistics for geromedicine trials.
items.body: Geroscience has advanced rapidly, yet its clinical translation remains limited. A central barrier is the lack of trial outcomes that capture the multidimensional effects of geroprotective interventions while meeting clinical and regulatory standards. Mortality is objective and regulatorily salient but often impractical. By contrast, surrogate measures of healthspan improve feasibility and may better reflect the quality of extended life, but they are generally considered soft endpoints that require further validation. Here, we propose hierarchical composite endpoints using time-to-worst-event analysis as a pragmatic and scientifically sound compromise. Participant pairs are compared using win statistics according to a prespecified clinical hierarchy, in which more severe and objective clinical events are prioritized, while health surrogates and biomarkers contribute information at lower tiers. When outcome selection, ordering and tie rules are clinically and mechanistically justified and agreed with regulators, this approach may improve geromedicine trial efficiency and allow overall treatment effects to be captured without compromising clinical priorities.
items.authors: Abdellatif M, Kim Y, Kroemer G.
items.title_zh: 老年医学试验的分层终点与胜利统计
items.summary_zh: 老年科学（Geroscience）快速发展，但其临床转化仍受限，主要障碍在于缺乏能够捕捉老年保护干预多维效果的试验结果，同时满足临床和监管标准。虽然死亡率是客观且符合监管要求的指标，但往往不切实际。相对而言，健康寿命（healthspan）的替代指标提高了可行性，可能更好地反映延长生命的质量，但通常被视为需要进一步验证的软终点。本文提出使用最坏事件发生时间分析的分层复合终点，作为务实且科学合理的折中方案。根据预先设定的临床层级，比较参与者对，优先考虑更严重和客观的临床事件，而健康替代指标和生物标志物则在较低层级提供信息。当结果选择、排序和平局规则在临床和机制上得到合理化并与监管机构达成一致时，该方法可能提高老年医学试验的效率，并在不妥协临床优先级的情况下捕捉整体治疗效果。
items.l1_lead: 本文提出了一种分层复合终点的方法，以提高老年医学试验的效率，兼顾临床优先级和多维效果的捕捉。
items.l2_summary:
老年科学（Geroscience）近年来发展迅速，但其临床转化面临诸多挑战，主要障碍在于缺乏能够全面捕捉老年保护干预多维效果的试验结果，同时又能满足临床和监管标准。尽管死亡率是一个客观且符合监管要求的指标，但在实际应用中往往显得不够切合实际。相比之下，健康寿命（healthspan）作为替代指标，能够更好地反映延长生命的质量，然而通常被视为需要进一步验证的软终点。为了解决这一问题，本文提出了一种使用最坏事件发生时间分析的分层复合终点的方法，作为务实且科学合理的折中方案。

该方法根据预先设定的临床层级，对参与者进行比较，优先考虑更严重和客观的临床事件，同时在较低层级提供健康替代指标和生物标志物的信息。这种分层设计不仅能够提高老年医学试验的效率，还能在不妥协临床优先级的情况下，全面捕捉整体治疗效果。通过合理化结果选择、排序和平局规则，并与监管机构达成一致，该方法有望在老年医学试验中实现更高的有效性。

总的来说，本文强调了在老年医学试验中采用分层复合终点的重要性，认为这一方法能够更好地平衡临床需求与监管要求，推动老年科学的临床转化进程。

items.title: Trial watch: antibody-drug conjugates in cancer therapy.
items.body: Antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) combine the target specificity of monoclonal antibodies with the cytotoxic potency of small-molecule payloads. In recent years ADCs have emerged as a clinically validated component of modern precision oncology. To date, more than a dozen ADCs have received FDA approval for oncologic indications, with additional agents approved regionally and hundreds of ADC-based regimens in clinical development. Collectively, these therapies have demonstrated clinical benefit across hematologic malignancies and solid tumors, including significant overall survival improvements in advanced phase clinical trials. In this Trial Watch, we provide an overview on available ADCs from early preclinical development to current clinical applications. We also summarize design principles underpinning clinically successful ADCs, including epitope targeting, linker chemistry, payload toxicity and drug-to-antibody ratio, and discuss how these features can influence pharmacokinetics, intracellular trafficking, bystander effect and toxicity. Finally, we discuss results from advanced-stage clinical trials and approved agents to define future directions.
items.authors: Doffe F, Deng X, Shen Z, Xue E, Schauer K, Kroemer G, Kepp O.
items.title_zh: 抗体药物偶联物在癌症治疗中的应用进展
items.summary_zh: 抗体药物偶联物（ADCs）将单克隆抗体的靶向特异性与小分子药物的细胞毒性结合在一起，近年来已成为现代精准肿瘤学的临床验证组成部分。目前，已有十多种ADCs获得FDA批准用于肿瘤治疗，其他地区也有相关药物获批，数百种基于ADCs的治疗方案正在临床开发中。这些疗法在血液恶性肿瘤和实体瘤中显示出临床益处，包括在晚期临床试验中显著改善总体生存率。本文概述了从早期临床前开发到当前临床应用的ADCs，并总结了成功ADCs的设计原则，如表位靶向、连接子化学、药物毒性和药物与抗体比率，讨论了这些特征如何影响药代动力学、细胞内运输、旁观者效应和毒性。最后，本文还讨论了晚期临床试验的结果及已批准药物，以明确未来的发展方向。
items.l1_lead: 抗体药物偶联物（ADCs）结合了靶向特异性与细胞毒性，已在癌症治疗中显示出显著临床益处，多个ADCs获得FDA批准并正在开发中。
items.l2_summary:
抗体药物偶联物（ADCs）是一种将单克隆抗体的靶向特异性与小分子药物的细胞毒性相结合的创新治疗方式，近年来在现代精准肿瘤学中取得了显著进展。目前，已有超过十种ADCs获得美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）的批准用于癌症治疗，其他地区也有相关药物获批，且数百种基于ADCs的治疗方案正在进行临床开发。这些疗法在血液恶性肿瘤和实体瘤中展现出良好的临床效果，尤其是在晚期临床试验中，显著改善了患者的总体生存率。

本文回顾了ADCs从早期临床前开发到当前临床应用的历程，并总结了成功ADCs的设计原则。这些原则包括表位靶向、连接子化学、药物毒性以及药物与抗体的比率等，这些特征对药代动力学、细胞内运输、旁观者效应和毒性等方面均有重要影响。通过对这些设计原则的深入分析，研究者能够更好地理解ADCs的作用机制及其在治疗中的潜力。

此外，本文还讨论了晚期临床试验的结果及已获批准的ADCs药物，明确了未来的发展方向。随着对ADCs的深入研究，预计将会有更多创新的治疗方案问世，为癌症患者带来新的希望。总的来说，ADCs作为一种新兴的治疗策略，正逐步成为癌症治疗的重要组成部分，其临床应用前景广阔。

items.title: Exploring Splicing-Energy Axis Associations to Diet and Longevity.
items.body: There is increasing evidence that nutrient composition, even without lowering total calorie intake, can shape lifespan through mechanisms independent of mitochondrial regulation. Brandon and colleagues recently reported that a low-protein, high-carbohydrate (LPHC) diet enriched with non-digestible cellulose, extends lifespan in mice by shifting the liver proteome through altered RNA splicing, a response different from the mitochondrial improvements typically seen with caloric restriction. The authors' findings support the "energy-splicing resilience axis," which proposes that changes in splicing help cells adapt to energetic and nutritional stress. We discuss how diet influences spliceosomal components such as SRSF1, linking nutrient sensing, AMPK signaling, and tissue-specific resilience pathways. We also consider the splicing paradox in aging, where beneficial isoforms increase despite a concomitant increase in splicing errors. Understanding how dietary and pharmacologic interventions modulate splicing may shed light on strategies to maintain homeostatic proteomes and support healthy longevity.
items.authors: Donega S, Gorospe M, Ferrucci L.
items.title_zh: 探讨剪接-能量轴与饮食及寿命的关系
items.summary_zh: 越来越多的证据表明，营养成分的变化，即使不降低总热量摄入，也能通过与线粒体调节无关的机制影响寿命。Brandon及其同事最近报道，富含不可消化纤维素的低蛋白高碳水化合物（LPHC）饮食通过改变RNA剪接，改变肝脏蛋白组，从而延长小鼠的寿命，这一反应与通常在热量限制下观察到的线粒体改善不同。作者的发现支持“能量-剪接韧性轴”（energy-splicing resilience axis）理论，认为剪接的变化帮助细胞适应能量和营养压力。文章讨论了饮食如何影响剪接体成分如SRSF1，连接营养感知、AMPK信号传导和组织特异性韧性通路。同时，考虑到衰老中的剪接悖论，即有益的异构体增加的同时剪接错误也增加。理解饮食和药物干预如何调节剪接，可能为维持稳态蛋白组和支持健康长寿提供新策略。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，富含不可消化纤维素的低蛋白高碳水化合物饮食通过改变RNA剪接延长小鼠寿命，支持“能量-剪接韧性轴”理论，揭示饮食对寿命的潜在影响。
items.l2_summary:
近年来，越来越多的研究表明，营养成分的变化可以在不降低总热量摄入的情况下，通过与线粒体调节无关的机制影响寿命。Brandon及其同事的最新研究发现，富含不可消化纤维素的低蛋白高碳水化合物（LPHC）饮食能够通过改变RNA剪接，进而改变肝脏蛋白组，从而延长小鼠的寿命。这一发现与通常在热量限制下观察到的线粒体改善机制有所不同，支持了“能量-剪接韧性轴”（energy-splicing resilience axis）理论，认为剪接的变化有助于细胞适应能量和营养压力。

研究中，作者探讨了饮食如何影响剪接体成分，如SRSF1（可变剪接调控因子），并将其与营养感知、AMPK（腺苷酸活化蛋白激酶）信号传导以及组织特异性韧性通路相连接。这一机制的理解对于揭示饮食对细胞功能的影响至关重要。同时，文章还提到了衰老过程中的剪接悖论，即在有益的异构体增加的同时，剪接错误的发生率也随之上升。这一现象提示我们，尽管剪接的变化可能有助于细胞适应环境压力，但也可能带来潜在的负面影响。

因此，理解饮食和药物干预如何调节剪接过程，可能为维持稳态蛋白组和支持健康长寿提供新的策略。这一研究为我们提供了新的视角，强调了营养成分对生命延续的重要性，并为未来的健康干预措施提供了理论基础。通过进一步探索这些机制，科学家们或许能够开发出更有效的饮食和药物干预方案，以促进健康老龄化和延长寿命。

items.title: Mitochondrial quality control in human ageing and longevity.
items.body: Mitochondria play central roles in cellular metabolism and in key processes such as inflammation, stress response, cell death and signalling. Mitochondrial quality control (MQC) mechanisms continuously monitor organelle integrity and function, and repair or eliminate damaged mitochondria to replace them with newly formed, healthy organelles. MQC is particularly important under metabolic or environmental stress conditions. Failure of MQC paves the way to chronic diseases, such as diabetes, metabolic syndromes and immunosenescence. This Review summarizes our current understanding of MQC biology in the context of healthy human longevity. We explore the regulation of MQC in physiological conditions and explain how the dysregulation of MQC in ageing negatively impacts systemic metabolism and immune function. We discuss emerging therapeutic strategies-such as NAD + , AMPK activators and caloric restriction-that maintain a robust MQC to improve metabolic resilience and illustrate how preclinical and clinical studies can leverage MQC as a potential gerotherapeutic target.
items.authors: Picca A, Ferrucci L.
items.title_zh: 线粒体质量控制在人体衰老与长寿中的作用
items.summary_zh: 线粒体在细胞代谢及炎症、应激反应、细胞死亡和信号传导等关键过程中发挥核心作用。线粒体质量控制（Mitochondrial quality control, MQC）机制持续监测线粒体的完整性和功能，修复或清除受损线粒体，以新形成的健康线粒体替代它们。MQC在代谢或环境压力条件下尤为重要。MQC的失效会导致慢性疾病，如糖尿病、代谢综合症和免疫衰老。本文综述了MQC生物学在健康人类长寿背景下的当前理解，探讨了MQC在生理条件下的调控，并解释了衰老中MQC失调如何对全身代谢和免疫功能产生负面影响。我们讨论了新兴的治疗策略，如NAD+、AMPK激活剂和热量限制，这些策略维持强健的MQC以改善代谢韧性，并说明了如何通过临床前和临床研究将MQC作为潜在的抗衰老治疗靶点。
items.l1_lead: 线粒体质量控制在衰老与长寿中至关重要，其失效与多种慢性疾病相关，维持MQC可改善代谢韧性并成为抗衰老治疗的新靶点。
items.l2_summary:
线粒体在细胞的代谢、炎症、应激反应、细胞死亡和信号传导等关键生理过程中扮演着核心角色。线粒体质量控制（Mitochondrial quality control, MQC）机制负责持续监测线粒体的完整性和功能，能够修复或清除受损的线粒体，并用新形成的健康线粒体替代它们。MQC在代谢或环境压力条件下显得尤为重要，因为其失效可能导致一系列慢性疾病，如糖尿病、代谢综合症和免疫衰老。本文综述了MQC在健康人类长寿背景下的生物学理解，探讨了其在生理条件下的调控机制，并分析了衰老过程中MQC失调对全身代谢和免疫功能的负面影响。

研究表明，MQC的有效性与个体的健康状况密切相关，尤其是在衰老过程中，MQC的失调会加剧代谢紊乱和免疫功能下降。为了应对这一问题，本文讨论了几种新兴的治疗策略，包括NAD+、AMPK激活剂和热量限制等，这些策略旨在维持强健的MQC，从而改善代谢韧性。通过临床前和临床研究，MQC被视为潜在的抗衰老治疗靶点，表明其在延缓衰老和促进长寿方面的重要性。

综上所述，MQC在维持线粒体功能和细胞健康中起着至关重要的作用，其失调与多种慢性疾病的发生密切相关。未来的研究应进一步探索MQC的调控机制及其在抗衰老治疗中的应用潜力，以期为延长健康寿命提供新的策略和方法。

items.title: Trial Watch - bispecific T cell engagers and higher-order multispecific immunotherapeutics.
items.body: Over the past decades, cancer immunotherapy has evolved into clinical practice, with bispecific T cell engagers (TCEs) and other higher-order multispecific immunotherapeutics emerging as approaches for precision immune modulation. These engineered antibodies redirect immune effector cells toward tumor targets, thereby eliciting coordinated antitumor immune responses. While substantial clinical success has been achieved in hematologic malignancies, major challenges, such as limited activity in solid tumors, continue to constrain broader application. In this Trial Watch, we summarize recent preclinical advances in the design and optimization of TCEs and multispecific immune engager platforms together with available clinical trial data. We further examine key pharmacokinetic, safety, resistance, and manufacturing considerations in immune engager development. Collectively, these findings highlight the increasing versatility of immune cell-redirecting immunotherapies and their pivotal role in shaping the next generation of precision cancer therapy.
items.authors: Xue E, Deng X, Doffe F, Kroemer G, Kepp O.
items.title_zh: 双特异性T细胞激活剂及多特异性免疫治疗进展
items.summary_zh: 近年来，癌症免疫治疗逐渐进入临床实践，双特异性T细胞激活剂（TCEs）及其他多特异性免疫治疗方法成为精准免疫调节的新途径。这些工程化抗体能够将免疫效应细胞引导至肿瘤靶点，从而引发协调的抗肿瘤免疫反应。尽管在血液恶性肿瘤中取得了显著的临床成功，但在实体肿瘤中的活性有限等主要挑战仍然制约着更广泛的应用。本文总结了TCEs和多特异性免疫激活平台的设计与优化的最新前临床进展，以及现有的临床试验数据。同时，我们还探讨了免疫激活剂开发中的关键药代动力学、安全性、耐药性和生产考虑。这些发现共同强调了免疫细胞重定向免疫治疗的日益多样性及其在塑造下一代精准癌症治疗中的关键作用。
items.l1_lead: 双特异性T细胞激活剂及多特异性免疫治疗在癌症免疫治疗中展现出潜力，但在实体肿瘤应用中仍面临挑战，需进一步优化设计与临床研究。
items.l2_summary:
近年来，癌症免疫治疗逐渐进入临床实践，双特异性T细胞激活剂（TCEs）及其他多特异性免疫治疗方法成为精准免疫调节的新途径。这些工程化抗体能够有效地将免疫效应细胞引导至肿瘤靶点，从而引发协调的抗肿瘤免疫反应。尽管在血液恶性肿瘤中取得了显著的临床成功，TCEs在实体肿瘤中的活性仍然有限，这一主要挑战制约了其更广泛的应用。本文总结了TCEs和多特异性免疫激活平台的设计与优化的最新前临床进展，以及现有的临床试验数据，强调了这些技术在癌症治疗中的潜力。

在前临床研究中，TCEs的设计和优化不断取得进展，研究者们通过改进抗体的结构和功能，增强其对肿瘤细胞的识别能力和免疫细胞的激活效果。同时，临床试验数据也显示出TCEs在特定类型的血液恶性肿瘤中表现出良好的疗效，然而在实体肿瘤中的应用效果仍需进一步探索。文章还探讨了免疫激活剂开发中的关键药代动力学、安全性、耐药性和生产考虑，这些因素对TCEs的临床应用至关重要。

总体来看，这些发现共同强调了免疫细胞重定向免疫治疗的日益多样性及其在塑造下一代精准癌症治疗中的关键作用。随着对TCEs及多特异性免疫治疗方法的深入研究，未来有望克服当前在实体肿瘤治疗中的局限性，推动癌症免疫治疗的进一步发展。

items.title: The prenatal sex steroid theory of autism after 25 years.
items.body: We first proposed the prenatal sex steroid theory of autism 25 years ago to account for a number of then-unexplained observations around autism, including (1) the more frequent diagnosis of autism in male than in female individuals and (2) apparent 'male-type' shifts in cognitive traits associated with autism, such as empathizing and systemizing. Here we review 25 years of research testing this theory. Early studies found that higher prenatal testosterone levels were associated with slower social, language and empathy development, greater attention to detail, stronger systemizing and more autistic traits. Subsequent studies suggested that both prenatal androgens and oestrogens are associated with autism. New methods in genetics and using stem-cell-derived neural organoids have further indicated the importance of sex steroid hormones for neurodevelopment, as well as atypical patterns in autism. These new findings support and open new lines of research into the prenatal sex steroid theory of autism.
items.authors: Baron-Cohen S, Tsompanidis A, Srivastava DP, Mill J, Lancaster MA, Adhya D, APEX consortium, Warrier V.
items.attribution_note: 协作组署名，ORCID 命中即采信
items.title_zh: 产前性激素理论与自闭症研究25年回顾
items.summary_zh: 本文回顾了产前性激素理论（prenatal sex steroid theory）提出25年来的研究进展，该理论旨在解释自闭症的多项未解现象，包括男性自闭症患者的比例高于女性，以及与自闭症相关的认知特征出现“男性化”倾向。早期研究发现，较高的产前睾酮水平与社交、语言和同理心发展缓慢、对细节的关注度提高、系统化能力增强及更多自闭症特征相关。后续研究表明，产前雄激素（androgens）和雌激素（oestrogens）均与自闭症相关。最新的遗传学方法和干细胞衍生的神经类器官研究进一步强调了性激素在神经发育中的重要性，以及自闭症中的非典型模式。这些新发现支持了产前性激素理论，并为未来的研究开辟了新方向。
items.l1_lead: 产前性激素理论在解释自闭症的性别差异和认知特征方面取得重要进展，最新研究强调性激素在神经发育中的关键作用，为未来研究提供新方向。
items.l2_summary:
本文回顾了产前性激素理论（prenatal sex steroid theory）提出25年来的研究进展，该理论旨在解释自闭症（autism）的一些未解现象，特别是男性自闭症患者的比例显著高于女性，以及自闭症相关的认知特征呈现出“男性化”倾向。早期研究发现，较高的产前睾酮水平与社交、语言和同理心的发展缓慢、对细节的关注度提高、系统化能力增强及更多自闭症特征相关。这些发现表明，产前雄激素（androgens）在自闭症的发病机制中可能发挥重要作用。

随着研究的深入，后续的研究也指出，产前雌激素（oestrogens）同样与自闭症的发展相关。这一发现拓宽了我们对性激素在自闭症中的作用的理解，强调了在神经发育过程中，性激素的平衡和相互作用可能对个体的认知和行为特征产生深远影响。最新的遗传学方法和干细胞衍生的神经类器官研究进一步支持了这一理论，揭示了性激素在神经发育中的重要性，以及自闭症中可能存在的非典型模式。

这些新发现不仅为产前性激素理论提供了更为坚实的证据基础，也为未来的研究开辟了新的方向，提示我们在探索自闭症的病因时，需更加关注性激素的作用及其在神经发育中的复杂机制。这一理论的持续发展，可能为自闭症的早期识别和干预提供新的思路和方法。

items.title: Genomic Perspective on Heterogeneity of Organs and Body Aging.
items.body: Aging is a heterogeneous process, with organ systems and individuals experiencing variable rates of decline that are not fully reflected by chronological age. This variability contributes to the complexity of system morbidity, which poses increasing challenges for clinical care and biomedical research. In this review, we discuss the heterogeneity of organ and whole-body aging and perspectives on genomics as possible mechanisms that relate to such heterogeneity. We discuss how static genomics, including nuclear genetic variants, and dynamic genetics, such as somatic mutations, epigenetic drifts, and mitochondrial DNA changes might explain the variable rate of aging across organ systems and the whole body. We discuss that the use of metrics that capture heterogeneity in organ and body aging is critical to identify genomic biomarkers of aging, clarifying mechanisms of adaptation versus decline.
items.authors: Salimi S, Raftery D, Ferrucci L.
items.title_zh: 基因组视角下的器官与身体衰老异质性
items.summary_zh: 衰老是一个异质性过程，器官系统和个体的衰退速率存在差异，这种差异并未完全通过生理年龄反映出来。这种变异性增加了系统发病率的复杂性，给临床护理和生物医学研究带来了挑战。本文讨论了器官和全身衰老的异质性，以及基因组学作为可能机制的视角。我们探讨了静态基因组（如核遗传变异）和动态遗传学（如体细胞突变、表观遗传漂移和线粒体DNA变化）如何解释器官系统和全身衰老速率的差异。我们认为，使用能够捕捉器官和身体衰老异质性的指标对于识别衰老的基因组生物标志物至关重要，有助于阐明适应与衰退的机制。
items.l1_lead: 衰老过程的异质性在器官和个体间表现出不同的衰退速率，基因组学可能揭示其机制，帮助识别衰老的生物标志物。
items.l2_summary:
衰老是一个复杂且异质性的过程，不同器官系统和个体在衰退速率上存在显著差异，这种差异并不能完全通过生理年龄来反映。这种变异性不仅增加了系统发病率的复杂性，还为临床护理和生物医学研究带来了诸多挑战。本文探讨了器官和全身衰老的异质性，并从基因组学的角度分析了可能的机制。研究指出，静态基因组（如核遗传变异）和动态遗传学（包括体细胞突变、表观遗传漂移和线粒体DNA变化）在解释器官系统和全身衰老速率的差异中起着重要作用。

具体而言，静态基因组的遗传变异可能为个体的衰老特征提供了基础，而动态遗传学则反映了随着时间推移而发生的基因组变化，这些变化可能影响细胞功能和组织健康。因此，理解这些基因组层面的变化对于揭示衰老机制至关重要。研究者们强调，采用能够有效捕捉器官和身体衰老异质性的指标，对于识别衰老的基因组生物标志物具有重要意义。这些生物标志物不仅有助于阐明适应与衰退的机制，还可能为个性化医疗和干预策略的制定提供科学依据。

综上所述，衰老的异质性不仅体现在不同个体之间，也体现在同一个体的不同器官系统中。通过深入研究基因组的静态和动态特征，科学家们希望能够更好地理解衰老过程，从而为改善老年人群的健康状况提供新的思路和方法。

items.title: AI proteomics: from protein identification to virtual cells.
items.body: Artificial intelligence (AI) is transforming scientific research, including proteomics. In this Perspective, we highlight key mass spectrometry (MS)-based proteomics areas where AI is driving innovation, ranging from protein identification to building AI virtual cells. These include improving peptide and protein identification and quantification; characterizing protein-protein interactions and protein complexes; advancing spatial and perturbation proteomics; integrating multi-omics data; and, ultimately, enabling AI virtual cells. Finally, we call for global collaboration among data producers, data consumers and other stakeholders to establish an AI-friendly ecosystem for MS-based proteomics, laying the foundation for transformative advancements in proteomics driven by AI.
items.authors: Sun Y, A J, Liu Z, Sun R, Qian L, Payne SH, Bittremieux W, Ralser M, Li C, Chen Y, Dong Z, Perez-Riverol Y, Khan A, Sander C, Aebersold R, Vizcaíno JA, Krieger JR, Yao J, Han W, Zhang L, Zhu Y, Xuan Y, Sun BB, Qiao L, He
items.attribution_note: 作者串被截断，ORCID 命中即采信
items.title_zh: 人工智能在蛋白质组学中的应用与发展
items.summary_zh: 人工智能（AI）正在改变科学研究，尤其是蛋白质组学领域。本文重点讨论了基于质谱（MS）的蛋白质组学中，AI推动创新的几个关键领域，包括蛋白质和肽的识别与定量、蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用及蛋白质复合物的表征、advancing spatial和扰动蛋白质组学、整合多组学数据，以及最终实现AI虚拟细胞。文章呼吁全球数据生产者、数据使用者及其他利益相关者之间的合作，以建立一个适合AI发展的MS基础蛋白质组学生态系统，为AI驱动的蛋白质组学变革奠定基础。
items.l1_lead: 人工智能正在推动蛋白质组学的创新发展，特别是在蛋白质识别、相互作用及多组学数据整合等领域，呼吁全球合作以建立适合AI发展的生态系统。
items.l2_summary:
人工智能（AI）正在深刻改变科学研究的面貌，尤其是在蛋白质组学（proteomics）领域。基于质谱（mass spectrometry, MS）的蛋白质组学中，AI的应用推动了多个关键领域的创新。首先，在蛋白质和肽的识别与定量方面，AI技术能够提高分析的准确性和效率，帮助研究人员更快速地识别复杂样本中的成分。其次，AI在蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用及蛋白质复合物的表征中也发挥了重要作用，通过深度学习等算法，能够更好地预测和分析这些相互作用的动态过程。

此外，AI还在空间蛋白质组学（spatial proteomics）和扰动蛋白质组学（perturbation proteomics）中取得了显著进展，能够处理和分析来自不同实验条件下的数据，揭示蛋白质在细胞内的空间分布和功能变化。整合多组学数据（multi-omics data）也是AI的重要应用领域，通过将蛋白质组学与基因组学、转录组学等其他组学数据结合，AI能够提供更全面的生物学视角，促进对生物系统的深入理解。

文章强调，推动AI在蛋白质组学中的应用需要全球数据生产者、数据使用者及其他利益相关者之间的紧密合作，以建立一个适合AI发展的MS基础蛋白质组学生态系统。这种合作不仅能够促进数据共享和标准化，还能为AI驱动的蛋白质组学变革奠定坚实的基础。通过这种方式，AI有望在未来实现虚拟细胞（virtual cell）的构建，进一步推动生物医学研究的进展。总之，AI在蛋白质组学中的应用前景广阔，期待其为科学研究带来更多的突破与创新。

items.title: The tragedy of Jason Arday - The Spectator
items.body:
原话：“He really wasn’t coping. He was being subjected to relentless scrutiny… ridicule, discrediting every detail of his life… He wasn’t coping with the loss of his career, the loss of his reputation. items.topic_zh: 对Jason Arday的同情与理解
items.claim_zh: Jason Arday在面对媒体的持续压力和职业生涯的丧失时，感到无法承受，缺乏必要的支持。
items.evidence_zh: 他被持续的审视和嘲笑所困扰，失去了职业和声誉。
items.article_body:
Coffee House Melanie McDonagh The tragedy of Jason Arday Saturday, August 15, 2026, 10:30 AM Jason Arday (Credit: BBC) Text settings Text size Small Medium Large Line Spacing Compact Normal Spacious Comments Share Share Melanie McDonagh
Copied Linkedin Messenger Email Simon Baron-Cohen, the distinguished Cambridge autism specialist, has been speaking movingly about his friend, Jason Arday, in a BBC radio interview. Baron-Cohen said the last contact he had with Arday was hours before he was found dead at an address in south London yesterday afternoon: “He really wasn’t coping. He was being subjected to relentless scrutiny… ridicule, discrediting every detail of his life… He wasn’t coping with the loss of his career, the loss of his reputation. He felt he couldn’t go on.”
Jason Arday was a victim, but not in the way that his political champions suggest
Baron-Cohen went on to talk about him as “an incredibly kind and gentle and caring and generous man”. From his own perspective, he observed, “at the heart of all this was a man who was diagnosed with autism and language differences…he needed support every step of the way… after the allegations of plagiarism, [the] media didn’t leave him alone.”
It is good to be reminded of Jason Arday as a friend, by a friend. For in death we all should be remembered in our humanity, even in our flawed humanity. And Jason Arday was very human; he bled. He was not just a totem of DEI (Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion), but as the Prof said, a vulnerable man. It’s sometimes hard for pundits, self included, to remember how terrifying it is to be at the heart of a media firestorm. Jason Arday isn’t the first to feel the pressure to be unbearable. We may not feel exactly guilt at participating in the row, but it would be strange if we didn’t feel sober, chastened, by his tragic end.
De mortuis nil nisi bonum is a good motto, but in Arday’s case, the difficulty about speaking no evil of the dead is in disentangling the man, the human being, from the issue. And the issue was quite legitimate: the apparent dearth of scrutiny of his successive appointments, the uncritical and unquestioned acceptance of his work and his claims as, for instance, a fundraiser. His family, in their pain, has talked about him as the victim of misinformation. This isn’t, I would say, the whole case, though this isn’t the time to rehearse the details.
Before his death becomes weaponized – as it already risks being – in the culture wars, we should make one thing clear, as I, in fact, did before he died. It is that the problem was not Jason Arday; it was with the individuals who lionized him, who promoted him beyond his capacities, who raised him up prematurely to stellar heights at an age which would have been remarkable for anyone, regardless of ethnicity. It is the individuals behind the system which created Jason Arday, the poster image of DEI, who should be asking themselves some questions.
Arday can hardly be blamed for not resisting this inexorable trajectory. And, I would say, the fault is with Cambridge for making a dud subject like Education a faculty on the same level as history or natural sciences or classics. Jason Arday was a victim, but not quite in the way that his political champions suggest.
He was also a man, a father, a son, a brother and an uncle, as his family have said, and it is as such he is being mourned. Requiescat in pace.
Melanie McDonagh is an Irish journalist working in London.

items.title_zh: 杰森·阿尔代的悲剧
items.summary_zh: 本文讨论了杰森·阿尔代在面对媒体持续压力和职业生涯丧失时的困境。阿尔代被诊断为自闭症（autism）和语言障碍（language differences），在经历抄袭指控后，他感到无法承受来自媒体的无情审视和嘲笑，缺乏必要的支持。他失去了职业和声誉，内心深处感到绝望，认为自己无法继续前行。文章强调了在这种情况下，社会对有特殊需求人士的支持和理解的重要性。
items.l1_lead: 杰森·阿尔代因媒体压力和职业危机感到绝望，突显了社会对特殊需求人士支持与理解的重要性。
items.l2_summary:
杰森·阿尔代的悲剧揭示了在媒体压力和职业生涯丧失的双重打击下，特殊需求人士所面临的困境。阿尔代被诊断为自闭症（autism）和语言障碍（language differences），这使他在面对外界的审视时显得更加脆弱。在经历了抄袭指控后，媒体的持续关注和无情的嘲笑让他感到无所适从，缺乏必要的支持与理解。他的职业生涯因此受到重创，声誉也随之崩塌，内心深处的绝望感愈发加重，令他认为自己无法继续前行。

文章强调了社会对有特殊需求人士的支持和理解的重要性，指出在面对困境时，缺乏适当的帮助和关怀可能会导致更严重的心理和情感问题。阿尔代的经历不仅是个人的悲剧，更是对社会如何对待特殊需求人士的深刻反思。通过他的故事，读者能够感受到在职业生涯和个人生活中，理解与支持的重要性，以及在面对困难时，社会应当提供怎样的帮助。杰森·阿尔代的遭遇提醒我们，只有通过建立一个更具包容性和理解的环境，才能真正帮助那些在逆境中挣扎的人们。

items.topic_zh: 评估夏威夷桉树作为建筑材料的可行性
items.claim_zh: 他认为夏威夷现有的桉树资源可以安全用于建筑，以满足社区的需求。
items.article_body:
August 10, 2026 UH News Reading time: 2 minutes
University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa researchers are working to determine whether Hawaiʻi -grown eucalyptus could become a reliable source of lumber for construction, helping reduce the state’s reliance on imported building materials while supporting healthier forests.
The project, led by Jun Wang, an assistant professor in the Department of Civil, Environmental and Construction Engineering , received a $300,000 USDA Forest Service Wood Innovation Grant to establish the engineering standards needed for eucalyptus to be used in structural applications.
Although Hawaiʻi has more than 34,000 acres of managed eucalyptus plantations, the wood is rarely used in construction because engineers and builders lack the design data needed to certify it for structural use. If successful, the research could create new opportunities for Hawaiʻi ’s forestry and wood products industries while reducing shipping costs, supply chain risks and carbon emissions associated with importing lumber. Researchers also say putting more eucalyptus to use could encourage better forest management by reducing excess wood that can contribute to wildfire fuel.
The research team will work with state agencies, forest landowners and industry partners to harvest trees, produce lumber and test its strength and durability. The findings will help establish engineering design values needed for commercial construction and could lay the groundwork for future engineered wood products made in Hawaiʻi .
“Our goal is to determine whether a resource that’s already growing in Hawaiʻi can safely be used to build the homes, schools and infrastructure our communities need,” Wang said. “If we can provide the engineering data the construction industry needs, we can help create a more resilient local building supply while giving our students the opportunity to solve real challenges facing Hawaiʻi .”
The research also will benefit students. Wang’s team received an $8,000 American Society for Engineering Education grant to incorporate Hawaiʻi -grown eucalyptus into civil engineering courses. The new curriculum will give students hands-on experience evaluating sustainable building materials by comparing locally grown eucalyptus with conventional construction materials.
Students will examine factors such as structural performance, carbon emissions and local sourcing while participating in research that addresses Hawaiʻi ’s unique environmental and construction challenges. Many members of the research team are UH students from Hawaiʻi who are helping develop solutions that could benefit the state’s future infrastructure and economy.
items.title_zh: 夏威夷桉树森林或成新建筑材料来源
items.summary_zh: 夏威夷大学系统的科学家们正在研究夏威夷现有的桉树资源是否可以安全地用于建筑，以满足社区对住房、学校和基础设施的需求。他们的目标是提供建筑行业所需的工程数据，从而帮助建立更具韧性的本地建筑材料供应。这不仅能解决夏威夷面临的实际挑战，还能为学生提供实践机会，培养他们的解决问题能力。科学家们认为，桉树作为一种可再生资源，具有潜力成为可持续建筑材料的来源。
items.l1_lead: 夏威夷大学的研究表明，桉树可作为可持续建筑材料，满足当地住房和基础设施需求，同时为学生提供实践机会。
items.l2_summary:
夏威夷大学系统的科学家们正在探索夏威夷现有的桉树（Eucalyptus）资源是否可以安全地用于建筑，以满足社区对住房、学校和基础设施的需求。随着夏威夷面临的住房危机和基础设施需求不断增加，寻找可持续的建筑材料显得尤为重要。研究团队的目标是提供建筑行业所需的工程数据，以支持建立更具韧性的本地建筑材料供应。这一研究不仅旨在解决实际的建筑需求，还为学生提供了实践机会，帮助他们培养解决问题的能力。

科学家们认为，桉树作为一种可再生资源，具有成为可持续建筑材料来源的潜力。通过对桉树的特性进行深入研究，团队希望能够确定其在建筑领域的应用安全性和有效性。这一研究不仅关注材料的物理性能，还将考虑环境影响和经济可行性，从而为夏威夷的建筑行业提供全面的支持。

在当前全球对可持续发展和绿色建筑材料需求日益增长的背景下，夏威夷的这一研究具有重要的现实意义。通过利用本地资源，夏威夷不仅可以减少对外部建筑材料的依赖，还能促进地方经济的发展，创造更多就业机会。总之，夏威夷大学的研究团队正在为未来的建筑行业开辟新的方向，推动可持续建筑材料的应用，助力社区建设与发展。

items.topic_zh: 关于对黑人的学术不公
items.claim_zh: 他认为存在一个种族主义的剧本，用以通过抄袭指控来打击黑人学者
items.article_body:
Listen to this article with a free profile 00:00 00:00 Jason Arday in London in 2023. Ken McKay / ITV via Shutterstock Share Add NBC News to Google Aug. 14, 2026, 4:28 PM EDT / Updated Aug. 15, 2026, 10:45 AM EDT By Marlene Lenthang A former Cambridge professor was found dead at his London home on Friday, one week after he resigned from his position at the esteemed university following accusations of plagiarism.
Jason Arday, 41, became the youngest Black professor at Cambridge when he was hired as a professor of sociology of education in 2023.
London’s Metropolitan Police force said it responded to a report of a man found unresponsive inside a property on Friday and that the man was pronounced dead at the scene, without naming Arday. Authorities said the death is being treated as “unexpected, but is not believed to be suspicious.”
“We are desperately saddened to hear this tragic news. Our heartfelt sympathies go to Jason Arday’s family and friends at this incredibly difficult time,” University of Cambridge Vice-Chancellor Deborah Prentice said Friday.
Arday was known for his neurodivergence; he had said he was diagnosed with autism as a child and was unable to speak until the age of 11. He went on to forge a path in academia as a scholar of race, inequality and education.
Arday had resigned on Aug. 5 following scrutiny over alleged plagiarism in his academic work and questions about his accomplishments.
Last month, questions regarding his qualifications were raised publicly by Nathan Cofnas, a former Cambridge philosophy researcher who left the institution after critiquing diversity, equity and inclusion programs.
The Times of London had subsequently published an analysis of Arday’s 2015 Ph.D. thesis highlighting passages that it said were “identical or near-identical” to an earlier paper written by another researcher.
In the weeks since, British media outlets led intense and prolonged scrutiny of Arday’s work, also interrogating a history of claims about his childhood and personal life.
A statement from Arday’s family said he was “a gentle man and who always wanted to see the best in everyone,” condemning critics who they said “would leave no stone unturned in their quest to undermine him.”
Cambridge professor Simon Baron-Cohen, director of the university’s Autism Research Centre, told the BBC he was in touch with Arday hours before his death.
He said Arday “was being subjected to relentless scrutiny, including ridicule, discrediting absolutely every detail of his life,” adding that he “wasn’t coping with the loss of his career, the loss of his reputation, and he felt he couldn’t go on.”
Baron-Cohen said that Arday had believed “there was a racist playbook to discredit Black academics in universities, and that they used accusations of plagiarism to try and bring down Black academics,” adding that Arday referred to former Harvard President Claudine Gay , who resigned two years ago while facing plagiarism allegations and criticism over her comments on antisemitism.
British Prime Minister Andy Burnham said Saturday that the death was “a tragedy on so many levels,” adding that “it’s not a moment for any rushing to judgment. It’s a moment for reflection, I would say.”

London Mayor Sadiq Khan said on X that Arday had faced “an unacceptable public hounding and campaign of abuse” and that he “was the victim of a pernicious public shaming that other people in his position simply wouldn’t have faced.”
Hacked Off, a campaign group that supports regulation of the media, called for an “inquiry into the culture and behaviour of the British press” following the death, saying scrutiny “went far beyond any limited public interest considerations around academic standards.”
While Cambridge initially defended Arday, on Aug. 5 it opened an investigation “following new information about Professor Arday’s qualifications and honorary appointments.”
In his resignation statement last week, Arday described his tenure as “the privilege of my life to teach my students,” but conceded “the years since my appointment have also been marked by an unrelenting level of public scrutiny and personal attack.”
“While criticism is an inevitable part of academic life, what I have experienced has gone far beyond scholarly disagreement. The relentless accusations, speculation and public commentary have taken a profound toll on me and on those I love,” he continued.
In a statement Thursday, Cambridge’s Prentice shared an update on the inquiry into Arday, saying the university would investigate the circumstances around his appointment by the Faculty of Education in 2022 and his time at Cambridge.
She also said she asked the university council’s deputy chair and council’s audit committee to establish terms for an independent review of all university processes that will take place alongside the probe into Arday.
In his resignation announcement, Arday said he reached a point where the “personal cost becomes too great.”
“For my own wellbeing, for my family, and for those who have stood by me throughout this difficult period, I have concluded that the only way to bring this chapter to an end is to step away,” he said.
Arday’s memoir, “Great and Unfortunate Things,” was released earlier this week in the U.S., giving an account of his childhood — from being diagnosed with autism and developmental delays at the age of 3 — to speaking by the age of 11 and reading and writing by the age of 18.
“Without romanticizing the struggle, this is a story of determination against seemingly insurmountable odds — and of a family and a small group of believers whose compassion helped him see what is possible,” a description for the book by publisher Simon & Schuster said.

items.l1_lead: 贾森·阿尔代因抄袭指控辞职后自杀，揭示了学术界对黑人学者的抹黑及其对心理健康的深远影响。
items.l2_summary: 贾森·阿尔代（Jason Aldine）是一位曾任剑桥大学教授的学者，近期因抄袭指控辞职，随后被发现死亡。阿尔代在辞职前经历了严厉的审视和公众的嘲笑，这使他感到难以承受职业和声誉的双重打击。他在接受采访时提到，自己认为这一切背后存在一个种族主义的剧本，旨在通过抄袭指控来打击黑人学者。他的观点揭示了在学术界中，针对黑人学者的抹黑行为不仅影响了他们的职业生涯，也对其心理健康造成了严重的负面影响。阿尔代的遭遇引发了对学术界中种族歧视问题的广泛关注，尤其是在当前社会对种族平等和公正的讨论日益增多的背景下。此事件不仅反映了个体在面对不公正指控时的脆弱，也突显了学术界在处理种族问题时的复杂性和挑战。阿尔代的死让人深思，如何在学术环境中建立一个更加包容和公正的氛围，以保护所有学者的声誉和心理健康。
